name: ToggleLogic
description: Owner-scoped skill-aware model routing for OpenClaw with learned policies, benchmark-capable Intelligence integration, bounded child execution, budget controls, audit records, and transparent cost estimates. Bring your own provider credentials. The separate ToggleLogic Intelligence package is privately distributed under its own license. Global and unattended enforcement require a future OpenClaw in-flight runtime safeguard.

mode.description: Routing mode. 'auto' uses a compatible separately licensed Intelligence package if present, else the cheap default if configured, else passthrough. 'passthrough' defers every selection to OpenClaw's default. 'configured' uses static configuredRoutes matched only against host-supplied task labels, then optional default. 'cheap' applies the deployment-declared cheapest default (a dumb static preference — no registry/benchmark). 'intelligence' requires the separate Intelligence package and reports unavailable rather than silently downgrading.

enabled.description: Whether ToggleLogic writes its routing decision log.

path.description: Routing decision log path (jsonl, one object per line). Tilde expansion supported.

rotateSizeMb.description: File size in MB at which the log rotates.

configuredRoutes.description: Static task-label-to-model mappings used in 'configured' mode. Labels may be supplied by the host as hookContext.taskType, hookContext.task, hookContext.capability, event.taskType, event.task, or event.metadata.taskType. `default` is optional fallback. Prompt text is never inspected.

cheapHeuristic.description: The simple cheapest-default (free tier). A DUMB, request-agnostic static preference: it never inspects the request, never consults a model registry/benchmark, and embeds no model names or prices. The deployment declares which of ITS models is the cheap default; the plugin just defaults to it (the user teaches real preferences via owner overrides). This is NOT the patented Intelligence selection engine.

default.description: A single model ref to default to (e.g. 'anthropic/claude-haiku-4-5').

order.description: Cheapest-first ordered list of model refs the DEPLOYMENT declares; the plugin uses order[0]. The plugin does not compute relative cost — the ordering is the deployment's declaration.

familyResolution.description: Optional family aliases for configured routes and a read-only host fallback-plan conformance check. Disabled by default. Reads the deployment's cached public Models.dev catalog, restricts candidates to explicitly approved providers and optionally accepted model refs, and requires complete non-zero pricing. ToggleLogic never writes the host fallback list.

catalogPath.description: Deployment-local Models.dev cache. No catalog ships in this package.

acceptedModels.description: Optional deployment acceptance allowlist. When present, family resolution cannot select a child outside these concrete provider/model refs.

hostPlan.description: Durable primary and ordered fallback family aliases. ToggleLogic resolves and audits this plan against agents.defaults.model but never mutates host configuration; deployment tooling materializes the concrete children.

intelligence.description: Detection of an optional, separately licensed ToggleLogic Intelligence package. The engine is developed publicly but is not included in ToggleLogic Free. When a compatible installation is present and 'intelligence'/'auto' mode is active, the plugin defers model selection to it.

enabled.description: Whether to attempt to detect a separately licensed Intelligence installation at startup.

path.description: Filesystem path where a compatible Intelligence installation is located. Tilde expansion supported.

registryPath.description: Optional path to the licensed layer's normalized model registry. Config-driven (deployment DATA); when unset, defaults to a path relative to the layer (<path>/normalized.json). No workspace path is hardcoded. Tilde expansion supported.

skillProfilesPath.description: Optional path to owner-taught skill routing profiles. When unset, Intelligence uses ~/.openclaw/togglelogic/skill-routing-profiles.json. Tilde expansion supported.

shadow.description: When true, evaluate and audit Intelligence decisions but never emit a model override. Use for a versioned canary before enabling live routing.

fallbackOnError.description: If true, errors from the intelligence layer yield no override (OpenClaw falls back to its default selection).

allowReleaseCandidate.description: Explicitly allow a private Intelligence release candidate for controlled canary use. Production default remains fail-closed to released builds.

ownerOverride.description: User/owner model override (the pin mechanism). A top-priority sticky model applied ABOVE routing; pins persist across turns until manually cleared.

enabled.description: Whether the routing hook checks for an active owner override before routing.

statePath.description: Path to the owner-override state file (JSON: {active, model_ref, provider_override?, ...}). Written by deployment tooling; read per request by this plugin. The plugin never writes it. Tilde expansion supported.

askConsumer.description: Deployment-supplied consumer script invoked at turn-end when an override is active and the turn is substantive, so the deployment can prompt the owner to switch back. The plugin authors no prompt content. Used only when features.ownerOverrideAsk is enabled.

features.description: Capability feature toggles. Each capability registers its hooks only when enabled.

routing.description: Model routing (before_model_resolve hook). Opt-in; also requires the gateway's plugins.entries.togglelogic.hooks.allowConversationAccess.

enabled.description: Whether to register the routing hook.

ownerOverrideAsk.description: Owner-override switch-back notifier (message_sending). Structurally invokes the deployment-supplied consumer so the owner can be prompted to switch back to the default. Opt-in; default off.

enabled.description: Whether to register the owner-override turn-end notifier.

costVisibility.description: Cost visibility (llm_output observe-only). Reports per-model/per-day DOLLAR cost from dynamic public pricing; unpriced-loud, never $0.00; never enforces. Opt-in; default off. Also requires the gateway's plugins.entries.togglelogic.hooks.allowConversationAccess (llm_output is a conversation hook).

enabled.description: Whether to register the cost-visibility observer.

governedEscalation.description: One-time owner approval gate for Intelligence-recommended external-model escalation. Requires routing and conversation access. Opt-in; default off.

enabled.description: Whether to register pre-run escalation approval and execution-receipt hooks.

skillRouting.description: Owner-taught, benchmark-backed routing by declared skill. Adds simulation and child-execution tools plus structured preflight support. Requires routing and a compatible Intelligence layer.

enabled.description: Whether to enable skill planning and learned skill profiles.

skillRouting.description: Runtime settings for the owner-taught skill routing coordinator. Model choice and benchmark logic remain in the separate Intelligence layer.

pendingStatePath.description: Mode-0600 restart-safe state for an unanswered educational choice.

monthlyCloudSpendUsd.description: STATIC fallback month-to-date cloud model spend used for preflight estimates and learned-profile budget eligibility when skillRouting.spend.enabled is false (or as the fallback when a live snapshot is unavailable and no finite cloud budget is declared). When skillRouting.spend.enabled is true this is superseded by the live, validated cloud-spend snapshot.

spend.description: Live cloud-spend consumption. When enabled, the coordinator reads a DEPLOYMENT-OWNED, versioned+fingerprinted, current-policy-month cloud-spend snapshot (written by scripts/generate-spend-snapshot.mjs from `openclaw gateway usage-cost --all-agents --expect-final --json`) as the AUTHORITATIVE spend — no caller hand-enters a number. The plugin re-verifies source/pair/month/freshness/fingerprint and FAILS CLOSED on unpriced CLOUD rows; unpriced LOCAL (Ollama) rows are expected $0. With a finite cloud budget declared, an unavailable/stale/invalid snapshot withholds cloud routes while local-capable routes remain. The universal no-skill fail-safe is unaffected (it runs before any model selection).

enabled.description: Consume the live cloud-spend snapshot for routing. Default false = use the static monthlyCloudSpendUsd.

snapshotPath.description: Path to the deployment-owned cloud-spend snapshot the plugin consumes and verifies (written by scripts/generate-spend-snapshot.mjs; the plugin never writes it and never shells out on a turn).

maxAgeHours.description: Freshness window. A snapshot older than this is STALE and fails closed. Sized for a daily refresh with slack; regenerate each refresh cycle.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the policy-month boundary. Empty defaults to skillRouting.ownerTimezone.

localProviders.description: Provider tokens treated as LOCAL ($0 marginal). A missing-cost row for one of these is expected and benign; a missing-cost row for any other (cloud) provider fails the snapshot closed.

finiteCloudBudgetApplies.description: Declare that a finite amortized cloud budget applies (see docs/ECONOMIC-PROFILE.md). When true, an unavailable/stale/invalid snapshot suppresses cloud routes (local-capable routes remain). When false, an unavailable snapshot falls back to the static monthlyCloudSpendUsd.

delta.description: Optional conservative top-up from the plugin's OWN cost log for cloud calls STRICTLY AFTER the snapshot's `through` instant in the policy month. Uses already-reconciled costUsd (no cache double-pricing). Off by default.

enabled.description: Apply the in-memory cost-log delta on top of the snapshot total.

costLogPath.description: Cost-log path (JSONL). Empty defaults to costVisibility.log.path.

maxBytes.description: Bounded tail read of the cost log so a large ledger can never blow memory on a turn.

maxChildTokens.description: Bounded-child token ceiling. A skill plan estimated above this fails loud instead of routing, preventing fat-main-session amplification.

maxChildCostUsd.description: Bounded-child estimated-cost ceiling. A routed skill whose estimate exceeds this is refused loudly.

maxChildToolCalls.description: Hard per-child tool-call COUNT ceiling, enforced live on the routed child by the before_tool_call guard. Bounds a runaway tool loop; it is NOT a model token/pass cap — the host exposes none (see docs/BOUNDED-CHILD-LIMITS.md).

skillTools.description: Per-skill bounded tool surface for the routed child, enforced by the before_tool_call guard. Keys are skill ids.

allowedTools.description: If set, only these tool names are allowed for the child; others are denied. Omit to leave the surface unrestricted (count-only).

maxToolCalls.description: Override the tool-call count ceiling for this skill's child.

disableTools.description: Run this skill's child with an exact empty tool surface (SubagentRunParams.disableTools).

skillIdentities.description: DEPLOYMENT-OWNED per-skill EXECUTION IDENTITY, keyed by verified installed skill id. The authoritative mailbox/account, sender identity, and send policy the routed child must act under — injected into the child's system prompt and surfaced (credential-free) in the audit/receipt. NEVER a credential/token; values are identity labels + policy sentences only. Not model-selectable: an identity is applied ONLY to a skill that actually resolved on the turn, so a Microsoft Graph (owner mailbox) identity can never cross onto a Gmail (gog) route or vice versa, and an identity is never supplied for a skill that did not resolve. Default empty (opt-in).

label.description: Short credential-free identity label used in the audit/receipt (e.g. "owner-mailbox:Al-Harlow"). Defaults to the mailbox if omitted.

mailbox.description: The authoritative mailbox/account for this skill (e.g. the owner's Microsoft 365 mailbox, or SAM's own clickitco@gmail.com). NOT a credential.

senderIdentity.description: Whose identity the child sends/writes as for this skill (e.g. "Al Harlow (the owner)" vs "SAM, in SAM's own identity").

authority.description: One-line authority statement (e.g. act as Al / on behalf of Al for the owner mailbox; never impersonate Al from SAM's own Gmail).

sendPolicy.description: Send policy: a specific owner instruction to send a NAMED message authorizes exactly that send; a general write/compose/draft/reply request is draft-only until the owner confirms the exact message.

resolverMode.description: How the before_agent_reply gate resolves skills from message text. 'deterministic' recognizes only exact installed skill-id/alias references from the LIVE inventory; 'off' disables text resolution.

ambiguityPolicy.description: Resolver-level policy for a skill invocation that names an unknown skill. Under the owner fail-closed rule the gate answers a named-unavailable skill with the no-skill fail-safe regardless.

useSnapshotInventory.description: Use the DEPLOYMENT-OWNED, versioned+fingerprinted inventory snapshot as the AUTHORITATIVE skill catalog. The snapshot is produced at deploy time by scripts/generate-skill-inventory.mjs from `openclaw skills list --json` (ELIGIBLE set). The plugin verifies source/version/freshness/fingerprint and FAILS CLOSED on a missing/stale/wrong-source/wrong-version/drifted snapshot; it never reads the workspace skill_manifest.json (proven stale) and never shells out on a turn. When true, skillCatalog only supplements aliases; set false to revert to skillCatalog as the membership source (dev/testing only).

inventorySnapshotPath.description: Path to the deployment-owned inventory snapshot the plugin consumes and verifies (written by scripts/generate-skill-inventory.mjs).

inventoryMarkerPath.description: Mode-0600 plugin-owned marker of the last-accepted inventory fingerprints, used for run-to-run drift detection (NOT the deployment snapshot; the plugin never writes the snapshot).

inventoryMaxAgeHours.description: Freshness window: a snapshot older than this is treated as STALE and fails closed. Regenerate the snapshot (and restart the plugin) whenever installed/eligible skills change.

clarifyOnMultiSkill.description: When more than one installed skill is referenced, ask one bounded clarification and execute nothing. Default false: the owner rule permits 'one or more' skills, so multi-skill tasks resolve.

calendar.description: Microsoft Graph /me/calendarView grounding port for time-sensitive skills (e.g. meeting-prep). When enabled AND bridge.command is set, the plugin SPAWNS the configured, deployment-owned, vault-backed bridge executable (a SUBPROCESS) with a bounded window, wall-clock timeout, and strict JSON validation, and uses its sanitized output as the authoritative calendar. The plugin holds no Graph credentials. Disabled, or enabled-but-unwired, it fails CLOSED (clarify, never fabricate). CAPABILITY: enabling calendar grants this plugin subprocess-execution of the configured command — see configContracts.dangerousFlags and docs/CAPABILITY-CONSENT.md.

enabled.description: Enable the authoritative calendar grounding check before a time-sensitive skill executes. DANGEROUS: true activates subprocess execution of bridge.command.

timeoutMs.description: Bridge lookup wall-clock timeout; the child is killed and the lookup fails closed on timeout.

bridge.description: The explicitly configured calendar bridge executable. Launched with execFile + an explicit argv array (NEVER a shell), so window bounds and all arguments are passed literally (injection-safe). Empty command = unwired = fails closed.

command.description: The bridge executable (e.g. "python3"). SUBPROCESS: the plugin executes this command. Empty leaves the port unwired.

args.description: Base argv passed before --start/--end (e.g. the absolute path to microsoft-graph/scripts/calendar_bridge.py).

cwd.description: Optional working directory for the bridge process.

env.description: Optional extra environment variables MERGED onto the parent env for the bridge process (string values only).

accountArg.description: Optional deployment account nickname forwarded as --account <value>.

nonActionCategories.description: Explicit deployment-owned non-action categories (conversation/control). The ONLY way a non-skill message bypasses the fail-closed gate; default empty so nothing is silently exempted.

patterns.description: Anchored regex sources tested against the raw message, e.g. "^\\s*/(stop|status|help)\\b".

ownerTimezone.description: IANA timezone used by time-sensitive skill contracts (e.g. meeting-prep) to evaluate the owner-local clock.

classifier.description: Bounded skill-resolution classifier — a pinned SYSTEM skill (own model assignment) that maps a natural-language request naming NO skill to a single ELIGIBLE skill AFTER deterministic exact/alias resolution returns none. Tool-free, minimal, light-context, schema-validated, confidence-thresholded, audited, and PROHIBITED from performing the task. OFF unless a model is pinned; none/low-confidence/malformed/disabled output yields the no-skill fail-safe (never guesses), and multiple plausible skills yield one clarification.

enabled.description: Enable the classifier stage. Treated as off unless a model is also pinned.

provider.description: Classifier transport provider. 'ollama' targets a local Ollama server.

model.description: Deployment-pinned classifier model id, e.g. 'llama3.1:8b'. Required to enable the classifier.

confidenceThreshold.description: Below this confidence, resolution is treated as no-skill (fail-safe).

timeoutMs.description: Classifier call timeout; a timeout fails safe to no-skill.

numCtx.description: Local model context window. The classifier is given each eligible skill's id + bounded description; the historical 2048 default silently truncated the reference host's 57-skill catalog. Default 8192 fits it with headroom; hard-bounded [2048, 32768].

intentRecipes.description: DEPLOYMENT-OWNED deterministic intent recipes, evaluated AFTER exact installed-skill/alias resolution returns none and BEFORE the bounded classifier. Each recipe is a declarative normalized-token rule (no code, no raw regex) that composes a natural-language request to one-or-more INSTALLED skills. A recipe resolves ONLY if every target skill is present in the fresh verified inventory; matching recipes that resolve to different skill sets fail closed with one clarification. Default empty (opt-in).

allTerms.description: EVERY term must appear (word-boundary, normalized) for the recipe to match.

anyTerms.description: At least ONE term must appear when this list is non-empty. A recipe must declare at least one allTerms or anyTerms entry, else it is dropped.

skillIds.description: One-or-more INSTALLED skill ids this recipe composes to; the recipe is inert unless all are in the verified inventory.

skillCatalog.description: Optional alias SUPPLEMENT for snapshot skills (id → extra match aliases). With useSnapshotInventory true this does NOT define membership; a configured id not present in the verified snapshot is reported as configured-but-not-installed and never resolves.

skillRequirements.description: DEPLOYMENT-OWNED per-skill CAPABILITY REQUIREMENTS (routing CONSTRAINTS, not learned model choices), keyed by verified installed skill id. A skill with no explicit entry inherits the conservative default (tool_calling_strong + requiresTools), so an unverified general-purpose-only local model is never offered for a tool-using skill (Microsoft Graph, Zoom). Opt a PROVEN tool-free skill DOWN to { requiredTier: 'general_purpose', requiresTools: false }. Every field validates independently and an invalid value fails closed to the conservative fallback (it can never widen). Aggregated (strictest) across a turn's resolved skills and passed to Intelligence.planSkills.

default.description: The deployment default requirement, coerced against the hard conservative fallback (tool_calling_strong + requiresTools).

requiredTier.description: Capability tier FLOOR: only models eligible at this tier may execute the skill.

privacy.description: Privacy posture; local_only forbids any cloud model.

requiresTools.description: The skill needs tool-calling; excludes general-purpose-only models.

minimumBenchmarkScore.description: Optional benchmark floor a candidate must meet.

maxCostUsdPerMonth.description: Optional per-skill monthly cost cap (min'd with the amortized cloud budget).

capabilityContract.description: Skill-specific benchmark dimensions used by the 1.7 Economy/Recommended/Premium marketplace. This is evidence configuration, never a model pin.

skills.description: Per verified installed skill id → its capability requirement. An entry for an id not in the verified inventory is simply never consulted.

scope.description: Canary scope. ACTIVE routing/education only for turns whose trusted hook identity matches every configured (non-empty) dimension; all other turns stay shadow/passthrough. Correction for the 2026-09-15 unscoped global canary.

enabled.description: Whether canary scope constraints are active. When false, active gating is inert (shadow/passthrough).

allowGlobal.description: Explicitly allow an UNCONSTRAINED (global) active canary. Fail-safe default false: without constraints or this flag, active gating stays inert.

requireOwner.description: Require the trusted sender to be an owner (senderIsOwner bit or ownerSenderIds match).

senderIds.description: Trusted channel-scoped sender ids, e.g. the owner's Telegram peer id.

ownerSenderIds.description: Owner allowlist used for the owner check when the host does not supply senderIsOwner on this hook.

governedEscalation.description: Governed escalation settings. General work can remain local; configured high-capability tiers are blocked before external model submission until the owner approves once.

localModel.description: Required local quarantine/model ref when governed escalation is enabled, for example ollama/gemma4:latest.

ttlMinutes.description: Minutes an approval request may remain pending.

statePath.description: Mode-0600 local state used to resume the blocked original request after a gateway restart.

externalDataNotice.default: this request and active conversation context will be sent to the selected external provider
externalDataNotice.description: Deployment-authored boundary notice shown before approval. ToggleLogic displays this text but does not infer the deployment's data policy.

approvalLanguage.description: Deployment-authored exact phrases normalized to affirmative or negative decisions. Defaults are intentionally strict; add locale- and product-specific wording here rather than changing router code.

displayNames.description: Optional deployment-authored labels used only in human-facing notices and receipts. Exact provider/model references remain in audit data.

audit.description: Structured audit log of consequential plugin actions (NIST 800-53 AU-2/AU-3/AU-12 schema bar). JSONL, append-only, rotated by size. Independent of the routing log.

enabled.description: Whether to write the audit log.

path.description: Audit log path. Tilde expansion supported.

rotateSizeMb.description: File size in MB at which the audit log rotates.

costVisibility.description: Cost-visibility settings (used when features.costVisibility.enabled). Observe-only; reports per-model/per-day dollar cost from dynamic public pricing. Never enforces.

attribution.description: Privacy-safe local fleet attribution. Values are non-secret slugs written only to the local cost ledger; ToggleLogic never sends them to Motherboard or any ToggleLogic service.

deploymentId.description: Stable deployment slug, for example acme-assistant or support-agent-01. When omitted, the local hostname is used.

costCenter.description: Optional non-secret billing cost-center slug. Do not place names, email addresses, account numbers, or credentials here.

log.description: The plugin's own cost log (JSONL, one row per call plus periodic loud summaries). Independent of the routing/audit logs.

enabled.description: Whether to write the cost log.

path.description: Cost log path. Tilde expansion supported.

rotateSizeMb.description: File size in MB at which the cost log rotates.

pricing.description: Dynamic public pricing. Fetched with a browser-like User-Agent, cached locally, refreshed on a slow cadence — never per-call, never from any Motherboard endpoint. Falls back to a bundled LiteLLM snapshot (MIT) when the source is unreachable.

sourceUrl.description: Public pricing source (Models.dev api.json; MIT, USD per million tokens).

cachePath.description: Local cache path for fetched pricing. Tilde expansion supported.

userPriceOverridePath.description: Optional deployment-supplied price map (DATA) taking highest priority. Tilde expansion supported. The plugin never writes it.

cacheReadMultiplier.description: Proxy multiplier applied to the input rate for cache-READ tokens ONLY when the source lacks explicit cache-tier rates. Reconciles the cost log and owner receipt onto one calculation; replaces the old full-input-rate cache billing.

cacheWriteMultiplier.description: Proxy multiplier applied to the input rate for cache-WRITE tokens when the source lacks explicit cache-tier rates.

summaryEveryCalls.description: Emit a loud day-summary line to the cost log every N observed calls.
